context.transcript:
Thank you for listening to Grifflin City News.
We are the leader in local news.
One of our top stories today is the opening of the Modern Art Museum in the City Center.
This event has attracted many visitors.
Go to our website to watch short discussions with these people and hear all the wonderful things they have to say about the museum and the city.
Up next, we have a live interview with Sung Hee Kwon, one of the artists whose work is being exhibited at the museum.
We already have callers waiting to ask her some questions.
You could be next.
We'd love to hear your voice on Grifflin City News.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢收听Grifflin City News。
我们是本地新闻的领导者。
我们今天的一条头条是市中心现代艺术博物馆的开幕式。
这个活动吸引了许多游客。
请访问我们的网站，观看与这些人士的简短讨论，并听他们对博物馆和这座城市所说的所有精彩内容。
接下来，我们将采访Sung Hee Kwon，她是正在博物馆展出的艺术家之一。
我们已经有来电者等候向她提问了。
您可能是下一个。
我们很期待在Grifflin City News上听到您的声音。
